name: smwgraphics-hong-kong
title: Hong Kong '97 - Font
description:
The font from Hong Kong '97 that's used in the opening cutscene.

Contains 2 alternate versions that include the 8 and 9 characters for those who may want to use them. Alt 1 overwrites the pawprint on the message in Yoshi's House.
Alt 2 overwrites the 1 and 2 graphics used in the 1 Player Game and 2 Player Game text from the title screen.

Update (10/2/2023):
Fixed the number 4.
